text:
The error came from the word "input" in two parameter comments ("input pair gm/Id" and "input pair L"). The checker reads it as a forbidden construct, so I reworded those comments to "diff pair". The design and sizing are unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 19.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # diff pair L
    "itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 40e-6),  # tail current
    "ic":    (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),   # folded cascode branch current
    "ugb_t": (7e6, 5.5e6, 12e6),     # design-target GBW (sets Cc)
    "i2":    (100e-6, 60e-6, 160e-6),# second-stage current
    "gmid11":(12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # 2nd stage NMOS gm/Id
    "L11":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # 2nd stage NMOS L
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # cascode / fold mirror L
    "rzk":   (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm11
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    it, ic, i2 = p["itail"], p["ic"], p["i2"]
    isrc = it / 2 + ic
    Lb, gn, gp = 1.0, 10.0, 8.0
    vds_n_t, vsd_p_t = 0.25, 0.3            # bottom mirror Vds, top source Vsd targets

    # ---- bias references ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gn, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    mb = lut.size("n", gn, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)              # ibias diode
    m0 = lut.size("n", gn, Lb, it, vds=mb0.vgs)                # tail (mirror)
    mpb0 = lut.size("p", gp, Lb, iref, vds=1.0)
    mpb = lut.size("p", gp, Lb, iref, vds=mpb0.vgs)            # PMOS reference diode
    m3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lb, isrc, vds=mpb0.vgs)             # fold current sources
    m12 = lut.size("p", gp, Lb, i2, vds=mpb0.vgs)              # 2nd-stage load

    # ---- signal devices ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    m5 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["Lc"], ic, vds=0.8, vsb=vsd_p_t)   # PMOS cascodes
    m7 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Lc"], ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vds_n_t)   # NMOS cascodes
    m9 = lut.size("n", 8.0, p["Lc"], ic, vds=vds_n_t)             # bottom mirror
    m11 = lut.size("n", p["gmid11"], p["L11"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # ---- cascode bias: diode + resistor ----
    mnc = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Lc"], iref, vds=0.6)
    Rn = max((m7.vgs + vds_n_t - mnc.vgs) / iref, 1e3)
    mpc = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["Lc"], iref, vds=1.0)
    Rp = max((m5.vgs + vsd_p_t - mpc.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    # ---- compensation ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["ugb_t"])
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m11.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MNB1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MPB", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MNB2", "vbpc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.R("RP", "pcd", "vbpc", Rp)
    n.dev("MPC", "pcd", "pcd", "vdd", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("MPB1", "vbnc", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.R("RN", "vbnc", "ncd", Rn)
    n.dev("MNC", "ncd", "ncd", "vss", "vss", mnc)
    # folded cascode first stage (vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M0", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "x", "vbpc", "fa", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o1", "vbpc", "fb", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "x", "vbnc", "y", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "o1", "vbnc", "z", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M9", "y", "x", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("M10", "z", "x", "vss", "vss", m9)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M11", "vout", "o1", "vss", "vss", m11)
    n.dev("M12", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m12)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    Rdn = (m7.gm / m7.gds) / m9.gds
    Rup = (m5.gm / m5.gds) / (m3.gds + m1.gds)
    Rout1 = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rdn + 1.0 / Rup)
    A1 = gm1 * Rout1
    A2 = m11.gm / (m11.gds + m12.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m11.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + m11.cdd + m12.cdd))
    if Rz > 1.0 / m11.gm:
        z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m11.gm))
        zterm = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    else:
        zterm = 0.0
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * (m11.cgg + 1e-14))
    pf = m5.gm / (2 * PI * (m5.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 1e-15))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + zterm \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pf))
    itot = iref + 3 * iref + 2 * isrc + i2
    power = VDD * itot
    swing = VDD - m11.vdsat - m12.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = min(it / Cc, i2 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew}
```
